segments.name: Mission Technology Solutions
segments.description: Provides full life-cycle engineering, science and technology support to military, intelligence, space and aviation programs for U.S., U.K. and Australian government agencies.
segments.evidence: Our Mission Technology Solutions business segment provides full life-cycle support solutions to defense, intelligence, space, aviation and other programs and missions for military and other government agencies primarily in the U.S., U.K. and Australia.

segments.name: Sustainable Technology Solutions
products: high-end engineering, design and program management
segments.description: Licenses proprietary process technologies and provides engineering, advisory and digital services to governments and industrial customers for energy transition and decarbonization.
segments.evidence: Our Sustainable Technology Solutions business segment is anchored by our portfolio of over 85 innovative, proprietary, sustainability-focused process technologies that reduce emissions, increase efficiency and/or accelerate and enable energy transition across the industrial base in four primary verticals: ammonia/syngas, chemical/petrochemicals, clean refining and circular process/circular economy solutions.

revenueModel.text: U.S. and allied government agencies and commercial and industrial clients pay for engineering, science, technology and logistics support services delivered under contracts and programs.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide services and technology to a diverse customer base, including domestic and foreign governments and commercial and industrial companies.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the Government Solutions reportable segment was renamed Mission Technology Solutions, while Sustainable Technology Solutions retained its name.
changes.evidence: As part of this realignment, our Government Solutions reportable segment has been renamed Mission Technology Solutions while Sustainable Technology Solutions has retained its name.

changes.text: HomeSafe was disposed of in fiscal 2025 and its results are reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: We disposed of HomeSafe in the second quarter of fiscal 2025 and determined that this disposal met the requirements to be reported as discontinued operations.

changes.text: In September 2025 the company announced its intention to spin off the Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate public company.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, we announced our intention to spin off our Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate, U.S. publicly-traded company (the "Planned Spin-Off").
